# Focused fixtures

These are unchanged text copies of promoted public-domain recipes under
`examples/public-domain-recipes/<name>/<name>.opensauce`. Tests verify the copies
against the current promoted sources. Provenance metadata stays in each fixture;
images are not copied because rendering emits references without fetching them.

| Fixture | Coverage |
|---|---|
| apple-pie | Baking, multiline assignments, Meanwhile, Optional, source mistake comments |
| banana-bread | Inline named choices and equipment alternatives |
| basic-waffles | Named choices, Repeat conditions, Meanwhile |
| carbonara | Ingredient parts, repeated roles, choices and optional instructions |
| ginger-garlic-broccoli | Equivalent amounts, source inconsistencies, multiple actions |
| gooseberry-pudding | Historical measures, unspecified temperature, implicit result |
| medieval-beef-soup | Historical/free quantities, implicit names and parts |
| no-knead-bread | Fractional and unusual quantities, implicit bread result |
| pavlova | Equivalent oven settings, approximate durations, optional serving |
| tiramisu | Egg parts, inherited subjects, Repeat and comments |

Synthetic tests additionally cover inline Markdown images, nested/inline groups,
group alternatives, malformed syntax, URL hashes, tabs/CRLF/Unicode, and API hooks.
